purpose: On train8m, does windowed PBT still beat a fixed-LR grid that reaches the learning rates PBT ended at? Validation-selected checkpoint of the train8m high fixed-LR grid (1.4-5.0e-5) on the frozen Stage 2A holdout, paired with the Stage 3 fixed-LR and windowed-PBT checkpoints, which are re-evaluated as references. The Stage 3 sealed test is not used.
